description: This file contains the implementation of a cash flow report in an ERP system, including functions to gather financial data, process cash flow accounts, generate chart data, and produce report summaries.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate the cash flow report based on filters, returning columns, data, chart, and summary.

methods.name: get_cash_flow_accounts
methods.description: Returns predefined cash flow account sections: Operations, Investing, and Financing.

methods.name: get_account_type_based_data
methods.description: Calculates data for a specific account type over a period list, considering accumulated values.

methods.name: get_account_type_based_gl_data
methods.description: Fetches GL entries sum for a given account type within a date range, considering filters.

methods.name: get_start_date
methods.description: Determines the start date for data calculation based on period and accumulated values.

methods.name: add_total_row_account
methods.description: Adds total rows for account sections in the report data.

methods.name: get_report_summary
methods.description: Generates a summary of the report data with labels and currency values.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Creates chart data structure for visualization based on report data.
